data.title: 时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅】午后阳光洒满温馨的猫咪咖啡厅，脱下灵装换上常服的狂三正怀抱着一只毛茸茸的三花猫，用指尖温柔地替它抓痒。她脸上绽放出毫无防备的纯真笑容——「呼呼，好乖好乖……啊，你刚才一直看着我吗？这种事情可不准说出去哦，会破坏我的形象的。」
data.promptProse: A sleeping calico rests securely against Kurumi's forearm on the cafe sofa as her free hand scratches behind its ear. She looks up with a surprised, unguarded smile above her loose black cardigan and choker. Cushions overlap the lower medium view, with warm wooden flooring beyond the sofa. Interior light and afternoon sun reveal the cat's patterned fur and her hands, leaving soft contact shadows beneath its body.
